svg.title: claudia - E7.11 architecture 3: consent and clients
svg.desc: Class diagram: a new ConsentRecord list beside the exit record, AiConsent is folded from it, core protocol methods ai_consent and set_ai_consent, an audience rule, admin API changes, and on the client side the web components, the shell manifest and the generated menus.
svg.text: E7.11 architecture 3 — the consent lives in the sealed document; clients only draw it
The owners' switch is written where the administrator cannot reach it. The shells add one menu entry; the dialog is the web page's, so the three apps and all clients behave the same.
shells (Linux GTK; macOS and Windows Neutralino)
bold coloured line = new or changed member of an existing class · «…» = kind · open triangle = is a
a second sealed list in the file,
owners only (like set_role); writes a ConsentRecord;
publishes "ai_consent_changed"; off takes effect at the
next round of a running question (the gate)
viewers see who allowed it, as the dialog shows
(a test fails until every new event is listed)
POST /settings/ai/test one question, no change (or inside PUT)
the key is never returned; only the last four characters
tests and the fake only; never
i18n: every new string goes through the catalogue (po/), the server's

the provider's name as its only variable.
